mapping_gt_to_key.type: category when non-null, otherwise etapeAnnote -> kind -> canonicalizeImmoCategory (frozen crosswalk)

mapping_gt_to_key.observed_sourceRef: sourceRef is null for 1018/1018 GT events; source_url and date_iso are therefore null
mapping_gt_to_key.consequence: all 1018 events are identity_unmappable and counted missed; the frozen gate internal label remains identity_key_incomplete in recall-gate.json
